test_title: RRB Group D 2025-26: General Intelligence & Reasoning - Live Test
subject: reasoning
question: Eight children, C, P, D, R, E, T, U and F, are sitting around a square table facing the center of the table. Four of them sit at the corners, while four sit exactly in the middle of the sides. U sits immediate right of P. P and E are sitting diagonally opposite each other. R and C are sitting diagonally opposite each other. F sits immediate right of C. P sits second to the left of C. T sits exactly between R and P. Who is the child sitting immediate left of E?
